questions.question: The ratio of the number of men and women in a company is 5 : 4. If the number of men and women increase by 16% and 15%, respectively, then what will be the new ratio of men and women ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of Men and Women = 5 : 4

Men are increased by 16%

Women are increased by 15%

**Concept used:**

Percentage increase = original quantity × Rate of % increase

Increased quantity = original quantity × (1 + Rate of % increase)

**Calculation:**

Let number of men = 50

And number of women = 40

Now, 16% of 50 = 50 × 16/100 = 8

 Increased men = 50 + 8 = 58

15% of 40 = 40 × 15/100 = 6

Increased women = 40 + 6 = 46

New ratio of men and women = 58 : 46

⇒ 29 : 23

**∴ The new ratio of men and women is 29 : 23.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Let men be 5X and women be 4X

Increased men = 5X × (1 + 0.16) = 5X × 1.16 (∵ 16% increase)

Increased women = 4X × (1 + 0.15) = 4X × 1.15 (∵ 15% increase)

New ratio = 5X × 1.16 : 4X × 1.15

⇒ 5 × 116 : 4 × 115

⇒ 29 : 23

**∴ The new ratio of men and women is 29 : 23. **

questions.question: What number must be added to each of the numbers 15, 9 and 5 so that the resulting numbers may be in a continued proportion?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For three numbers a, b, and c to be in continued proportion after adding a number x, the direct formula is:

x = (b² − a × c) ÷ (a + c − 2b)

Here, a = 15, b = 9, and c = 5.

x = (9² − 15 × 5) ÷ (15 + 5 − 2 × 9)

x = (81 − 75) ÷ (20 − 18) = 6 ÷ 2 = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The numbers are 15, 9, and 5.

**Formula Used:**

If three numbers A, B, and C are in continued proportion, then A : B :: B : C, which means the product of extremes equals the product of means (B² = A × C).

questions.question: If the selling price of an article is ₹ 900 and the discount is 40%, then find its marked price (in ₹).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__****SP = Rs. 900 and discount = 40% **SP = (100 - Discount)/100 × MP

⇒ 900 = (100 - 40)/100 × MP

⇒ 900 = 60/100 × MP

⇒ MP =** 1500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

Selling Price = Rs.900

Discount = 40%

**Formula used:**

Discount (D) = MP - SP

Discount percent (D%) = (D/MP) × 100

Where SP = selling price

MP = marked price

**Calculation:**

SP = Rs.900

D% = 40%

D% = (MP - SP)/MP × 100

⇒ 40 = (MP - 900)/MP × 100

⇒ 40/100 = 1 - 900/MP

⇒ 900/MP = 1 - 2/5 = 3/5

⇒ MP = 900 × 5/3

⇒ MP = Rs.1500

**∴ The marked price is Rs.1500.**

questions.question: If the number 6523678pq is divisible by 99, the missing digits p and q are :
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The number 6523678pq is divisible by 99.

**Concept used:**

Divisibility rule of 9 ⇒ for any number to be divisible by 9, the sum of its digit should be divisible by 9.

Divisibility rule of 11 ⇒ the subtraction of alternate digits of the number should add up to zero or be divisible by 11.

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

6523678pq is divisible by 99

This means it is divisible by (11 × 9)

∴ It is divisible by both 11 and 9

Divisibility by 9,

⇒ (6 + 5 + 2 + 3 + 6 + 7 + 8 + p + q) should be divisible by 9

⇒ (37 + p + q) is divisible by 9 

⇒ p + q = 8 .....(1) [ The nearest multiple of 9 greater than 37 is 45. Hence we have to add 8 to the 37 to make it a multiple of 9]

Divisibility by 11,

⇒ (6 + 2 + 6 + 8 + q) - (5 + 3 + 7 + p) = 11

⇒ 22 + q - 15 - p = 11

⇒ q - p = 11 - 7 = 4 .....(2)

Adding (1) and (2), we get

⇒ 2 × q = 12 ⇒ q = 6

p = 8 - q = 8 - 6

⇒ p = 2

**∴ The value of p = 2 and q = 6.**

questions.question: The area of the floor of a cubical room is 192 m². The length of the longest rod that can be kept in that room is :
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of the floor of a cubical room = 192 m² 

**Formula used:**

Diagonal of the cube = √3 × side of cube

Floor area = side² (floor of the cube is in the shape of a square)

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

The floor area of the cube = side² 

 ⇒ 192 = side²

⇒ side of cube = √192 = 8√ 3 m

Diagonal = √3 × side of the cube

⇒ √3 × 8 × √3 

⇒ 8 × 3 = 24 m

**∴ The length of the longest rod that can be kept in that room is 24 m.**

questions.question: The average weight of 6 persons increases by 1.5 kg when a new person comes in place of one of them who was weighing 65 kg. What is the weight of the new person ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average weight of 6 people increases by 1.5 kg

A person weighing 65 kg is replaced by a new person.

**Concept used:**

Average of N number of quantities = (Sum of N quantities)/(Total number of quantities)

**Calculations:**

Total increase in weight = 6 × 1.5 = 9 kg

This increment of weight is because of the replacement of a person of 65 kg with a new person

This implies that the new person has a weight of 9 kg more than the person whose weight is 65 kg

**∴ The weight of new person = 65 + 9 = 74 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** Let the weight of the new person be x kg

And the average weight of 6 persons be A kg

Sum of weights of all persons = Average weight of all persons × Number of persons

⇒ A × 6 - 65 + x = (A + 1.5) × 6

⇒ A × 6 - 65 + x = A × 6 + 9

⇒ x - 65 = 9

⇒ x = 9 + 65 = 74 kg

**∴ The weight of the new person is 74 kg**.

questions.question: By selling an article for ₹254.38, there is a gain of 10.6%. If it is sold for ₹224.25, then the loss/gain percentage will be :
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling price = Rs.254.38

Gain % = 10.6% 

Final selling price = Rs.224.25

**Formula used:**

CP = SP/(100 + Gain%) × 100

Gain % = {(SP - CP)/CP} × 100

Loss % = {(CP - SP)/CP} × 100, where

CP = cost price

SP = selling price

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Gain % = 10.6 = (254.38 - CP)/CP × 100

⇒ 10.6/100 = (254.38 - CP)/CP

⇒ CP × 0.106 = 254.38 - CP

⇒ 1.106 × CP = 254.38

⇒ CP = 254.38/1.106

⇒ CP = Rs.230

Now, final SP = 224.25

Loss % = {(CP - SP)/CP} × 100

Loss % = {(230 - 224.25)/230} × 100

⇒ (5.75/230) × 100

⇒ Loss % = 2.5%

**∴ If the article is sold for 224.25, then the loss % will be 2.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**SP = 254.38 & Gain = 10.6%

Now, CP = SP/(100 + Gain%) × 100

⇒ CP = 254.38/(100 + 10.6) × 100 

⇒ CP = 254.38/110.6 × 100

⇒ CP = 230 then,

Final SP = 224.25 and CP = 230

Loss % = (230 - 224.25)/230 × 100

⇒** Loss % = 2.5%**

Divisibility rule of 8 = Last three-digit of the number should be divisible by 8.

**Calculation:**

questions.question: What is the difference between the compound interest on ₹3,000 for 1 year at 5% per annum compounded yearly and that compounded half - yearly ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs.3000 and Rate % = 5% per annum

**Formula used:**

Amount = Principal × (1 + R/100)ⁿ

Compound Interest (CI) = [P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ - P]

Where P = principal, R = rate %, n = time

Effective Rate of interest when compounded half yearly at R % for one year

⇒ Rₑffₑ꜀ₜᵢvₑ = R% + R% + R%²/100

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

When compounded yearly, rate = 5%, n = 1

CI = 3000 × (1 + 5/100) - 3000

⇒ CI (yearly) = 3000 × 5/100 = 150

When compounded half-yearly,

Rate = 5/2% = 2.5%, n = 2

CI = 3000 × [(1 + 2.5/100)² - 1]

⇒ 3000 × (1.025² - 1) = 3000 × .050625

⇒ CI (half yearly) = 151.875

CI (half yearly) - CI (yearly) = 151.875 - 150

⇒ 1.875 = Rs. 1(7)/(8) 

∴ **The difference between the compound interest compounded half yearly and yearly is Rs. 1(7)/(8)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Rate of interest when compounded yearly = 5%

When compounded half-yearly, 

Rate (half yearly) = 5/2 = 2.5%

As this will be compounded every 6 months for 1 year, 

Hence the effective rate of interest will be = 2.5% + 2.5% + 2.5%²/100

⇒ Rₑffₑ꜀ₜᵢvₑ= 5.0625%

∴ Difference in CI = 3000 × (Rₑffₑ꜀ₜᵢvₑ - R)

⇒ 3000 × (5.0625% - 5%) = 3000 × 0.0625/100

⇒ 1.875 = Rs. 1(7)/(8)

**∴ The difference between the compound interest compounded half yearly and yearly is Rs. 1(7)/(8)**

questions.question: A, B and C can complete a work in 60, 30 and 20 days, respectively. In how many days can A complete the work if he is assisted by B and C together on every fifth day ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A complete the work in 60 days

B completes the work in 30 days

C completes the work in 20 days

**Concept used:**

Work done = Efficiency × time taken

**Calculation:**

A's efficiency = 1/60

B's efficiency = 1/30

C's efficiency = 1/20

Work done in 4 days (done by A alone) = 4× 1/60 = 1/15

5th day work (done by A + B + C) = 1/60 + 1/30 + 1/20

⇒ (1 + 2 + 3)/60 = 6/60 = 1/10

Work done in 5 days

⇒ 1/15 + 1/10 = (2 + 3)/30 = 5/30 = 1/6

⇒ 1/6 unit = 5 days

⇒ 1 unit = 5 × 6 = 30 days

**∴ The work will be completed in 30 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85e310b30caec937359f3fa6a4f4f45f3cab7a67a517b175e2a6a99fe5e431b4.png] 

Work done in 4 days (by A only) = 4 units

Work done on 5th day (by A + B + C together) = 1 + 2 + 3 = 6 units

Total work done in 5 days = 4 + 6 = 10 units

In 5 days 10 unit work is done

1 unit work done in = 5/10 = 1/2 days

Time to complete 60 units work = 1/2 × 60 = 30 days

**∴ The work will be completed in 30 days.**

questions.question: When x is subtracted from each of 43, 38, 11 and 10, then the numbers so obtained in this order are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between (11x + 3) and (9x - 2) ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

When x is subtracted from each of 43, 38, 11 and 10, then the numbers so obtained in this order are in proportion.

**Concept used:**

If a, b, c, and d are in proportion,

Then a/b = c/d

Mean proportion of two numbers a and b is = √(a × b)

**Calculation:**

(43 - x)/(38 - x) = (11 - x)(10 - x)

⇒ (43 - x)(10 - x) = (11 - x)(38 - x)

⇒ 430 - 43x - 10x + x² = 418 - 11x - 38x + x²

⇒ 430 - 53x = 418 - 49x

⇒ 4x = 430 - 418 = 12

⇒ x = 12/4 = 3

Now, mean proportional between (11x + 3) and (9x - 2) is

⇒ √(11x + 3)(9x - 2) 

⇒ √(33 + 3)(27 - 2) = √(36 × 25)

⇒ 30

**∴ The mean proportional between (11x + 3) and (9x - 2) is 30.**

questions.question: During a flight of 900 km, an aircraft was slowed down due to bad weather. Its average speed for the trip was reduced by 300 km/h and the time of flight increased by 30 min. The original duration of the flight was :
questions.solution:
**Given :**

Distance = 900 km

Average speed is reduced by 300 km/h 

Time of flight is increased by 30 min. 

**Concept used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Average speed = Total distance/Total time

**Calculation:**

Let the original time of flight be T hrs

So, original average speed = 900/T 

When average speed is reduced by 300 km/h and time of flight is increased by 30 min.

According to the question,

Reduced average speed = 900/T - 300

New time of flight = (T + 1/2) hrs

New average speed = 900/(T + 1/2)

Equating average speed, we get

⇒ (900/T) - 300 = 900/(T + 0.5)

⇒ (3/T) - 1 = 3/(T + 0.5)

⇒ (3 - T)/T = 3/(T + 0.5)

⇒ (3 - T)(T + 0.5) = 3T 

⇒ T² + 0.5T - 1.5 = 0

⇒ 2T² + T - 3 = 0

⇒ (T - 1)(2T + 3) = 0

⇒ T - 1 = 0 ⇒ T = 1 hr

**∴ The original time of flight is 1 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**In such type of problems, use the formula directly

(S1 × S2)/(S1 - S2) × Time difference (in hours) = Distance (in km)

where S1 and S2 are the initial and final average speeds (in km/hr)

⇒ Let original average speed be S km/hr

⇒ S × (S - 300)/300 × 1/2 = 900

⇒ S × (S - 300) = 900 × 600

⇒ On comparing, we can tell directly that S = 900 km/hr

∴ The original time of flight = 900/900 =** 1 hr.**

questions.question: Akhil drives a car from his home to office at an average speed of 50 km/h and reaches office 10 minutes early. But one day due to some problem with the car, he could drive at an average speed of 30 km/h only and reached office 10 minutes late. How far is his office from home ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

If average speed = 50 km/h, then time taken is 10 minutes early than the scheduled time

If average speed = 30 km/h, then time taken is 10 minutes late from the scheduled time

**Concept used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Average speed = Total distance/Total time

If the distance is constant, then

Speed ∝ 1/Time

**Calculation:**

Let the distance be X km, and the scheduled time be T min.

According to the concept,

X = 50 × (T - 10)

also, X = 30 × (T + 10)

Equating the above two equations,

50 × (T - 10) = 30 × (T + 10)

⇒ (T + 10)/(T - 10) = 5/3

⇒ T/10 = 4 = 40

⇒ T = 40 min.

X = 50 × [(40 - 10)/60] = 50 × 1/2

⇒ X = 25 km

**∴ The distance covered by Akhil is 25 km.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**Distance is constant, therefore speed ∝ 1/time

The ratio of average speed = 5 : 3

Ratio of Time = 3 : 5

Difference between the time = 5 - 3 = 2 unit

According to question difference between the time is = T + 10 - (T - 10) = 20 minutes

Here T is the scheduled time

⇒ 2 units = 20 minutes

⇒ 3 units = 30 minutes or 1/2 hr

Akhil takes 30 minutes or half an hour when he drives at 50 km/hr

Distance covered by Akhil = 50 × 1/2 = **25 km**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**In this type of problem, use the direct formula.

Distance (in km) = (S1 × S2)/(S1 - S2) × Time difference (in hrs)

Where, S1 and S2 are the two given average speeds.

S1 = 50 km/h, S2 = 30 km/h, Time difference = 20 minutes = 1/3 hr

⇒ Distance = (50 × 30)/20 × 1/3

⇒ 75/3 = 25 km

**∴ The distance covered by Akhil is 25 km.**

questions.question: The average of seven consecutive positive integers is 259. If the next five odd numbers are included, then what is the average of all the numbers (correct to two decimal places) ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 7 consecutive positive integers = 259

**Concept used:**

Average of N integers = Sum of all integers/Total number of integers

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Let the 7 consecutive integers be

a, a + 1, a + 2, a + 3, a + 4, a +5, a + 6 and next 5 consecutive odd integers are a + 7, a + 9, a + 11, a + 13, a + 15

Sum of first seven integers = 7a + 21

Sum = Average × Total integers

⇒ 7a + 21 = 259 × 7

⇒ a = (1813 - 21)/7 = 256

Sum of all the integers = 12a + 76 

Average = (12a + 76)/12

⇒ a + 76/12

⇒ 256 + 6.33

⇒ Average = 262.33

**∴ The average of all the numbers is 262.33**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**Average of N consecutive integers = (N + 1)/2

Average of N consecutive even integers = N+1

Average of N consecutive odd integers = N

Where N = number of terms

questions.question: Two numbers X and Y are such that the sum of 3% of X and 2% of Y is two - third of the sum of 2% of X and 6% of Y. The ratio of three times of X to two times of Y is :
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Cancel out the % sign and solve directly:

⇒ 3(3X + 2Y) = 2(2X + 6Y)

⇒ 9X + 6Y = 4X + 12Y

⇒ 5X = 6Y ⇒ X/Y = 6/5

⇒ Required Ratio = (3 × 6) : (2 × 5) = 18 : 10 = 9 : 5

**∴ The correct answer is 9 : 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of 3% of X and 2% of Y = ²/₃ × (Sum of 2% of X and 6% of Y)

 Ratio Visualization
 
 3X
 
 18 units
 
 2Y
 
 10 units
 
 Ratio = 18 : 10 = 9 : 5

**Calculations:**

⇒ ³/₁₀₀ × X + ²/₁₀₀ × Y = ²/₃ × (²/₁₀₀ × X + ⁶/₁₀₀ × Y)

⇒ 3X + 2Y = ²/₃ × (2X + 6Y)

⇒ 3 × (3X + 2Y) = 2 × (2X + 6Y)

⇒ 9X + 6Y = 4X + 12Y

⇒ 9X − 4X = 12Y − 6Y

⇒ 5X = 6Y

⇒ X/Y = ⁶/₅

We need to find the ratio of 3X to 2Y:

⇒ ³X/₂Y = ³/₂ × X/Y

⇒ ³X/₂Y = ³/₂ × ⁶/₅

⇒ ³X/₂Y = ¹⁸/₁₀ = ⁹/₅

**∴ The correct answer is 9 : 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio & Proportion

Four numbers a, b, c, and d are in proportion if a:b = c:d. The product of means equals the product of extremes (b × c = a × d).

Componendo & Dividendo

If a/b = c/d, then by the rule of componendo and dividendo, (a+b)/(a−b) = (c+d)/(c−d).

Duplicate & Sub-duplicate Ratio

The duplicate ratio of a:b is a²:b², and the sub-duplicate ratio is √a:√b.
